name: Key Parser
description: Inspect a key and show its algorithm, type, size, curve, public key fingerprint and RSA private parameters.

results.params: This private key carries RSA private parameters (modulus, private exponent and CRT coefficients). Do not share them.

examples.label: Inspect an RSA public key: algorithm, size and fingerprint

hints.fingerprint: The fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the public key SPKI, so a private key and its public key share the same fingerprint.
hints.params: Private parameters are only returned when a **private** key is parsed explicitly; responses are never cached.

faq.q: Can I compare two keys with the fingerprint?
faq.a: Yes. A private key and its public key share a fingerprint, so different fingerprints mean different keys.

faq.q: Does parsing decrypt an encrypted private key?
faq.a: No. The normalized output stays encrypted, exactly like the input.
